column1: # The anime pack's own lines (mods.h: text.tsv): the game's line TAB the pack's. Only where words.tsv's swaps
# wouldn't read right (two hers that aren't the same woman, a grandmother twice); everything else is the swaps.
A ship with black sails came alongside one night. The captain took his hat off to her. Pirates don't take their hats off.
column2: A ship with black sails came alongside one night. The captain took her hat off to our ship. Pirates don't take their hats off.

column1: The Queen, the divers call it. Calypso feeds it ships, and the Admiral pays her for every one. Something of his is down there with it.
column2: The Queen, the divers call it. Calypso feeds it ships, and the Admiral pays her for every one. Something of the Admiral's is down there with it.

column1: My grandfather fought a sea serpent with his bare hands. My grandmother says it was a big eel. Grandmother lies.
column2: My great-aunt fought a sea serpent with her bare hands. My grandmother says it was a big eel. Grandmother lies.

column1: She dined with him that night, and every week after. He taught her the stars and the guns, and the patience of a man who plans in decades.
column2: She dined with the Admiral that night, and every week after. The Admiral taught her the stars and the guns, and the patience of a woman who plans in decades.

column1: She wrote that Miss Vell could not be spared. It was the only time she ever refused him, and he never spoke of it again.
column2: She wrote that Miss Vell could not be spared. It was the only time she ever refused the Admiral, and the Admiral never spoke of it again.

column1: They had me patching up the men who built his iron, Captain. I saw what he means to do with her. Let's not let him.
column2: They had me patching up the women who built her iron, Captain. I saw what she means to do with our ship. Let's not let her.

column1: I'm not going. Tell him the master's mate of the Wren is needed on the Wren.
column2: I'm not going. Tell the Admiral the master's mate of the Wren is needed on the Wren.
